en: Color-tinted vintage view of a rural riverside scene with a multi‑storey wooden industrial building beside the water and several wooden houses on a low hill in the background. Leafless birch trees stand along the riverbank, rustic wooden fences cross the foreground, and dense forest lies beyond. The image has a printed caption in the sky area that reads "Möbelfabriken, Kvillsfors."
